title: Harness Configuration
description: Schema for .harnessrc configuration file - GitHub integration settings for Harness

version.description: Schema version. Currently only '1' is supported.

issueTemplate.description: Path to the GitHub Issue template file.

path.description: Relative path to the issue template file.

productBacklog.description: Project number for the Product Backlog board.

sprintBoard.description: Project number for the Sprint Board.

template.description: Template for milestone names. '{number}' is replaced with the sprint number.

customFields.description: Mapping of semantic field names to GitHub custom field names.

size.description: Custom field name for PBI size estimate.

sizeActual.description: Custom field name for PBI actual size.

sequence.description: Custom field name for PBI sequence number.

effortInitial.description: Custom field name for initial effort estimate (pre-plan total intervention count).

effortPlaned.description: Custom field name for planned effort estimate (post-plan total intervention count).

effortActual.description: Custom field name for actual effort (completed total intervention count).

varianceText.description: Custom field name for variance analysis text (multi-line).
